title: Query strings with repeated keys
prompt:
`parseQuery` in src/query.js breaks the product filters: `?tag=a&tag=b` keeps only `b`, `+` is not a space and
percent-encoded text is left encoded. Fix it: a leading `?` is optional, repeated keys give an array in order,
`+` means a space, keys and values are percent-decoded, a key without `=` has the value `""`, and empty pieces
(`a=1&&b=2`) are ignored. A malformed escape (`%zz`) keeps the raw text instead of throwing.
